blocks.text: Ionizing radiation istemal karne wale imaging ke tareeqe is baat par chalte hain ke radiation maddah se kaise amal karti hai: tissue se guzarte photons absorb (jazb) ya scatter (bikhar) ho sakte hain, aur energy ke jama hone aur kam hone ka yahi pattern detector par naapne ke qabil signal banata hai. Nuclear medicine mein radiation mareez ke andar se aati hai, ek di gayi radioactive dawa (radiopharmaceutical) se; is liye signal jism ki shakal (anatomy) se zyada us ka kaam (physiological function) dikhata hai. Ek aham tareeqa SPECT (Single Photon Emission Computed Tomography) hai: gamma chhorne wala tracer jism mein dala jata hai aur ghoomta hua gamma camera mukhtalif rukh se bohat si tasveerein (projection views) leta hai; in se tracer ki taqseem ki cross-sectional tasveerein banai jati hain jo khoon ki rasai (perfusion) aur aza ke kaam ki 3D maloomat deti hain. PET (Positron Emission Tomography) isi soch ko positron chhorne wale tracers se aage barhata hai: positron tissue mein thora sa faasla tay kar ke ek electron se mil kar annihilate (dono khatam) hota hai aur do gamma photons taqreeban mukhalif simton mein nikalte hain; in dono photons ko coincidence mein (ek hi lamhe) pakar kar machine waqiye ki jagah maloom karti aur tracer ke jama hone ka naqsha banati hai. Is liye PET non-invasive tareeqa hai jo cell/molecule ki satah par metabolic aur biochemical sargarmi ki tasveer banata hai; yeh cancer ki jaldi pehchan aur stage maloom karne, dimagh ke kaam ki jaanch aur dil ki kharabiyon ko wazeh banawati tabdeeli se pehle pakarne ke liye bohat qeemti hai (Fig. 20.10, PET scanner ki tasveer).
PET scan kaise kaam karta hai

PET scanning machine ka khaaka Fig. 20.11 mein hai. PET scan mein radioactive tracer ki thori si miqdar nas (vein) mein injection se di jati hai. Khoon tracer ko le jata hai aur yeh zyada sargarm (active) tissues mein zyada jama hota hai, jaise bohat se cancers ya dimagh aur dil ke kaam karte hisse. Tracer ke unstable nuclei toot'te (decay) hue positrons chhorte hain. Har positron thora sa faasla tay kar ke qareeb ke tissue ke electron se milta hai. Milne par positron aur electron annihilate hote hain aur un ka mass energy ban kar do gamma-ray photons ki shakal mein mukhalif simton mein nikalta hai. Mareez ke gird ring mein lage detectors in photon ke joron ko pakar kar signal computer ko bhejte hain, jo saaf tasveer banata hai ke tracer kahan jama hua. PET tasveer ke zyada roshan hisse zyada tracer, yani zyada sargarm tissue, dikhate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: positron emitter, aik atom jis ka nucleus electrons ke darmiyan positron chhorta hai; positron electron se mil kar khatam (annihilate) hota aur do gamma-rays mukhalif simton mein bhejta hai. Darmiyan: PET scanner ki ring, couch par mareez aur mareez se ring tak gamma-rays. Mura teer daen taraf computer display tak jata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tracer ka nucleus positron chhorta hai; positron qareeb ke electron se mil kar khatam hota aur 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays mukhalif simton mein nikalti hain. Scanner ki ring dono ko aik saath pakarti hai aur computer tasveer banata hai. Kitab ki shakal mein 'Nuctrus' (sahi: Nucleus) aur 'Y-RAYS' (sahi: gamma-rays) chhapa hai, aur 'Positron-electron annihilation' scanner se computer wale teer par likha hai; annihilation jism ke andar hota hai, is liye hum ne yeh label annihilation ke nuqte par lagaya hai.
Cancer ke ilaj mein medical physics

Medical physics cancer ki pehchan aur ilaj mein bhi bohat aham hai, khaas taur par radiotherapy mein, jo high energy radiation (kitab ke alfaaz: high energy particles) se rasoli ke cells ko maarti hai aur sehatmand tissues ko kam se kam nuqsan deti hai. Radiation therapy ke do bare tareeqe hain: teletherapy, jis mein radiation jism ke bahar rakhi machine se di jati hai, aur brachytherapy, jis mein radioactive source rasoli ke andar ya bilkul qareeb rakha jata hai.

Medical physicists bhi oncology (cancer ke ilaj ki) team ka hissa hain. Yeh machinon ki quality ki yaqeen dahani, ilaj ke waqt ka hisaab, ilaj ki planning aur cancer wale hisse mein dose ki taqseem ka naqsha banane ke mahir hote hain. Yeh radiation oncologists, dosimetrists (dose naapne wale mahir) aur laboratory technicians ke saath mil kar har ilaj ko mehfooz aur kaamyab banate hain.

blocks.prompt: PET scanning mein coincidence detection ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf woh gamma rays ke jore gine jate hain jo aik hi lamhe mukhalif detectors par pohanchein, is liye har waqia do detectors ko jorne wali lakeer par rakha ja sakta hai; is se annihilation ki jagah milti aur ghair-mutalliqa akele photons rad hote hain.

items: SPECT: gamma chhorne wala tracer aur ghoomta gamma camera.
PET: tracer ka positron electron se annihilate hota hai; do gamma photons mukhalif simton mein, coincidence mein pakre jate hain.
PET kaam (function) dikhata hai: cancer, dimagh, dil.
Radiotherapy: teletherapy (bahar se) aur brachytherapy (andar ya qareeb source).
